Description: Admin can view complaints and related data
Admin can assign or reassign a complaint to staff
Admin can view all staff profiles
Admin can create or update any staff profile
Admin can view staff availability slots
Admin can create or delete availability slots
Resident can submit a new complaint
Resident can cancel their own complaint
Resident can add follow-up comments on their own complaint
Resident can re-escalate an unresolved complaint
Staff can view complaints and related data
Staff can accept or deny assignments and update complaint status
Staff can update their own profile only
Staff can view their own availability slots
